description: operator speak prefs- acronyms, replacements, inline style

bullet_capitalization.rule: lowercase first word after `-` unless genuinely proper noun or acronym in context

heading_capitalization.rule: capitalize first word on # ## ### headings and bold section openers; proper nouns/acronyms preserved; bullets keep lowercase-first rule

inline_style.and_as_plus: prefer X + Y over X and Y inline

code_tokens.rule: single backticks on paths, files, classes, vars, branches, error codes, env vars, CLI
